europe_now.title: Tornado strikes French village causing injuries and damage
europe_now.summary: A tornado swept through a village in southern France, injuring dozens and damaging homes. The event left many residents without shelter and prompted emergency response.

sources.headline: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
Tornado devastates village in southwestern France’s Aude region

europe_now.title: Ukraine faces significant defense funding gap as Western aid delays
europe_now.summary: Western deliveries of military aid to Ukraine have fallen short, leaving a funding gap of approximately twenty‑three billion euros. This shortfall threatens the country’s ability to sustain its defense operations.

sources.headline: Ukraine faces €23B defense funding hole as Western cash comes too slow
Ukraine faces €23B defense funding hole as Western cash lags

top_stories.title: France and Saudi Arabia expand bilateral cooperation
top_stories.summary: France and Saudi Arabia have agreed to deepen ties across sectors such as defense, energy, and culture. As part of the agreement, Saudi Arabia has pledged six billion euros for a theme park project near Paris.

sources.headline: Saudi Arabia to invest €6 billion in theme parks near Paris, Macron says
Saudi Arabia to invest €6B in massive French theme park site

top_stories.title: Spain convenes security meeting over Ceuta migrant situation
top_stories.summary: Spanish authorities called a national security meeting to address the ongoing migrant pressure in Ceuta. The meeting occurred twenty‑six days after the crisis began and aims to coordinate border and humanitarian measures.

sources.headline: Spain’s Sánchez calls national security meeting 26 days into Ceuta migration crisis

top_stories.title: Poland implements regulation recognising foreign same-sex marriages
top_stories.summary: Poland has brought into force a regulation that recognises same‑sex marriages performed abroad. The measure allows foreign‑married same‑sex couples to have their unions acknowledged under Polish law.
